reviewed_by: Codex evidence review and independent read-only critic /root/review_divergence_patch, 2026-10-20
scope: Valid nonaliasing x86 contexts, mapped source rows, counters0..4; eight concrete state fixtures. Provisional native reconstruction, not whole-game acceptance.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Binary Ninja and RE-Agent Radare2 identify retail 0x00506F00; independent angr recovers four exact blocks with no unresolved jumps.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: The x86 replay calls both bodies with one context pointer on the stack and compares EAX as either the original context or the incremented integer index. Host pointer widths remain an adapter limitation.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: Offsets BC,68,DD0,E8,F8 and 12-byte row stride are present in the selected retail instructions. Index increment uses uint32 wrap in the candidate and passes the FFFFFFFF fixture.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: Negative/disabled rows clear a DWORD at E8; enabled rows write the DWORD, stack slot, active global and counter. The replay compares all 512 context bytes and the first16 stack words. Valid counters0..4 only.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: Retail leaf has no calls. Candidate writes stack before reloading F8, then active state and counter. Independent critic confirmed ordering for valid nonaliasing contexts; arbitrary aliases and backing-store overflow remain excluded.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: Negative and disabled rows return context; enabled rows return the incremented index, including uint32 wrap. Retail has no null guard or 64-entry cap; removed candidate-only branches. Overflow behavior is not verified.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: This function performs integer/pointer operations and no floating-point arithmetic.

limits: OpenIGI did not invoke this symbol in the paired game capture; runtime integration remains unverified.
Native signature names/types remain inferred, not a universal ABI guarantee.
Counter >=64, arbitrary aliases, invalid memory and overlapping retail globals are outside tested scope.
Portable host pointer widths and the fixed-size global array differ from the retail process layout.
The source digest binds a shared workspace file containing other agents changes; no release attestation.
